items.title: Eddie B. Edwards Interview, 1959-07-01
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...some guy named Red in the 30s I believe just before the war some fellow from New Orleans but I don't know who that would be... [INTERVIEWEE] yes yes that was a excellent engagement...

Red in on trumpet too somebody Red I couldn't find out his last name I think Nick told me about it you know but they had some guy named Red in the 30s I believe just before the war some fellow from New Orleans but I don't know who that would be I don't know and you put you were with Catherine Dunham too
